ledger.claim: The rider did precisely what POL-NS-04(a) requires. At 10:06:47, inside the waiting window that ran from the 10:06:19 wait-timer start to the 10:13:19 cancellation, she wrote 'im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you', and at 10:08:47 she wrote 'hello? are you here'. Both messages are locating or coordinating on their face: the first states that she cannot see the vehicle and asks for the driver's position, the second repeats the request for contact. The chat_log holds exactly the two messages that trip_record.chat_message_count records for this trip, so nothing is missing from the exchange POL-NS-04(a) asks the Judge to read.

POL-NS-04(b) is satisfied, and satisfied twice over. The chat_log contains no message from the driver at all, and both of the rider's messages carry read_at: null - they were never opened. Trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so no in-app voice call was placed before the driver terminated the trip, and the cancellation came at 10:13:19, which is 6 minutes 32 seconds after the rider's first message and 4 minutes 32 seconds after her second. The 120 second reply window had expired twice before the driver cancelled, and he neither posted a reply nor called.

POL-NS-04(c) is affirmatively satisfied on admissible fixes, not merely undecidable and not failed. The driver's trace carries a rider track with 67 fixes running from 10:04:47 to 10:14:42, and all 67 are qualifying fixes - rider_qualifying_fix_count equals rider_fix_count at 67, so not one was filtered out - whose greatest distance from the pickup pin is 20.89 m (mean 17.66 m, minimum 13.95 m). That is well inside the 100 m rider_presence_radius_m fixed for a STANDARD zone class, and inside even the 50 m arrival radius the driver's own arrival test uses for this zone: the rider's device stayed closer to the pin than the driver's vehicle was required to be.

All three limbs of POL-NS-04 therefore hold, and the clause does its work: the rider is exonerated, the cancellation fee is refunded in full and no driver compensation is payable. The money is exactly where it should be in the ledger: fare_breakdown shows the cancellation_fee line at 4.50 and total_charged at 4.50, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The entire contested amount is the cancellation fee, so the refund licensed by POL-NS-04 is the whole of it - FULL_REFUND of SGD 4.50 to the filing party, with no driver compensation alongside it.

The driver's statement that he 'waited the full time' does not answer this claim. Waiting is not the test POL-NS-04 sets, and the clause expressly displaces the outcome under POL-NS-01 wherever its three limbs hold - it applies whether or not the driver complied with the arrival and dwell conditions. The driver's own trace makes the point rather than defeating it: his longest qualifying in-geofence run is a continuous 420 seconds from 10:06:17 to 10:13:17, so he was holding position while the rider stood within about 21 m of the pin and messaged him twice, and he answered neither message nor the door. An unanswered locating message during the waiting window is the driver-side coordination failure POL-NS-04 was written to capture, and it is the reason the fee for this trip is not chargeable.

The rider's track cannot be discounted as thin or broken, because the trace carrying it is clean. EV-GPS-02715 is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with no issues recorded; it holds 84 fixes over 100.0% coverage at a 10 second sample interval, max_gap_sec is 0.0 and the gaps array is empty, so there is no sampling gap anywhere near the 120 second threshold at which POL-NS-08(b) would impair a trace. The 67/67 qualifying rider fixes relied on above therefore stand as admissible evidence of the rider's presence, with no impairment to name and nothing to discount.

There is no traffic advisory on this pickup road at all: EV-ADVIS-02715-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and carries the issue MISSING_ARTIFACT - no advisory covers Blk 55 Lengkok Bahru in this window. The absence is citable and it closes a door rather than opening one. POL-NS-06(i) can only be run where a present and populated advisory carries KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT, and that limb is unavailable here; nothing on this record puts the driver under a kerbside constraint that could explain or excuse his failure to make contact with a rider waiting within about 21 m of his own pickup pin.

The trip record carries the driver's arrival event - 'I'm Here' tapped at 2026-08-24T10:06:17 - and the GPS trace independently places him inside the STANDARD arrival radius of 50 m from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, which is timestamped 10:06:17, a dwell_start_offset of 0.0 s. Limbs (a) and (b) of POL-NS-01 are therefore satisfied on the platform's own telemetry, the arrival marker and the geofence entry coinciding to the second.

The driver then held position inside that geofence for a continuous 420 seconds - 44 qualifying fixes running unbroken from 10:06:17 to 10:13:17 - against a free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this trip and a null no_show_threshold_sec, so no longer threshold cuts the dwell down. POL-NS-01(c) is met with 240 seconds to spare, and the shortfall computed on this trace is minus 240 seconds, not a shortfall at all.

The trace on which the arrival test is run is unimpaired: 100.0% coverage, a 10-second sample interval against a 10-second expected interval, 84 driver fixes, no gaps recorded and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, with 44 fixes inside the 50 m radius. POL-NS-02's three-consecutive-fix test is met many times over, and nothing approaches the 120-second gap that POL-NS-08(b) treats as a policy-level impairment, so there is no basis to discount the arrival or the dwell.

The trip was terminated by the driver at 10:13:19 - 422 seconds after the first qualifying in-geofence fix - under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises, and the record shows no boarding event and a null started_at. Limb (d) is satisfied: the cancellation falls after the required dwell had already elapsed.

No false-arrival case arises under POL-NS-05: the derived arrival facts put the driver inside the 50 m radius at the arrival timestamp itself, so he was nowhere near the 300 m distance trigger, and what follows is a single continuous in-geofence dwell rather than a vehicle still in motion. The marker is true and the waiting clock needs no recomputation.

With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force - SGD 3.60 - the same figure the fare ledger derives. The anti-farming check does not trip, and only the two counters the clause permits may be used: no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the absolute limb of 4, and 1 against 134 completed_trips_30d is a rate of 0.007, below the 0.08 limb. Both limbs must hold together and neither does.

EV-ADVIS-02715-01 is MISSING - no advisory covers this pickup - and I disclose it as impaired rather than present it as clean: weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. The driver relies on it only as the absence it is, and it decides nothing, because he never left the geofence: the dwell is one unbroken 420-second in-geofence interval, so the accumulation limb of POL-NS-06(i) has nothing to add and the driver does not assert it against a MISSING artifact.

No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is engaged on this record: the admissible artifacts do not contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; the same-party dispute counters read 0 and 0, under the 2 that limb (c) requires; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 against the 3 limb (d) names, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is clean; and the deciding facts rest on complete artifacts carrying weight 1.0, so limb (e) is not reached. This case is decidable on the money, not for a reviewer.

I do not contest the coordination facts, and the driver advances no coordination defence he cannot support: the chat log shows two locating messages from the rider, at 10:06:47 and 10:08:47, both delivered and neither read, the record shows no reply from the driver and an empty in_app_calls list, and the rider's track keeps his device within 20.9 m of the pin. On that record all three limbs of POL-NS-04 are made out, and I say so rather than stretch the point; the driver's claims above stand on their own evidence as to arrival, dwell, reason code and compensation.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02715 does not stand and is refunded to the rider in full. No compensation is paid to the driver.

What the record establishes. The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 10:06:17 and EV-GPS-02715 places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from that moment: 44 qualifying fixes in one unbroken in-geofence run of 420 seconds, 10:06:17 to 10:13:17, against the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec; no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold cuts the dwell down). He cancelled at 10:13:19 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, a code POL-NS-01(d) recognises, with no boarding event and a null started_at. On the driver-side evidence alone POL-NS-01 limbs (a) to (d) hold, no POL-NS-05 false-arrival issue arises (he was inside the radius, nowhere near the 300 m or 15 km/h trigger, so the clock needs no recomputation), and POL-NS-07 would fix his payout at SGD 3.60, being 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee (the fare ledger's derived money block states the same figure). The anti-farming check is clean: no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the absolute limb of 4, and 1 against completed_trips_30d of 134 is a rate of 0.007, below the 0.08 limb; both limbs must trip together and neither does.

Why the fee is nevertheless refunded. POL-NS-04 displaces POL-NS-01 where three conditions hold, and all three hold here. (a) EV-CHAT-02715 carries two rider messages inside the waiting window - 'im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you' at 10:06:47 and 'hello? are you here' at 10:08:47 - both locating or coordinating on their face, and the log holds exactly the 2 messages trip_record.chat_message_count records, so nothing is missing from the exchange. (b) The driver posted no reply, both rider messages carry read_at null, and trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array; the cancellation came at 10:13:19, six and a half minutes after the first message, so the 120 second reply window had expired twice and no call was made. (c) The rider track inside EV-GPS-02715 has 67 of 67 qualifying fixes (not one filtered out), with a greatest distance of 20.89 m from the pickup pin and a mean of 17.66 m - well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider_presence_radius_m, and inside even the 50 m radius the driver's own arrival test uses. POL-NS-04 therefore exonerates the rider, refunds the cancellation fee in full and makes no driver compensation payable. The driver's statement that he 'waited the full time' is accepted as far as it goes and the trace confirms it, but waiting is not the test POL-NS-04 sets, and a driver who holds position while a rider about 21 m away messages him twice without answer has not met the coordination duty the clause enforces; the driver's own submission does not contest these coordination facts. POL-NS-01 is explicit that the fee stands only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces its limbs, and POL-NS-04 is that clause.

Evidence integrity. Nothing is impaired under POL-NS-08. Clock skew is 0 seconds (the arrival event 10:06:17 coincides with the nearest fix); the trace holds 84 fixes, 100.0 percent coverage, a 10 second cadence, no gaps and a 0.0 second maximum gap, so POL-NS-08(b) is not approached; the chat log reconciles with chat_message_count; and the fare ledger's cancellation_fee line of SGD 4.50 equals the net fee produced by the resolution rule (platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact sits at weight 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.0 and no discounted- or impaired-evidence narration is engaged.

The missing traffic advisory. EV-ADVIS-02715-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue MISSING_ARTIFACT; no advisory covers this pickup in this window. It is disclosed rather than relied on: it carries no fact, makes POL-NS-06(i) unavailable, and decides nothing here, the dwell being a single unbroken 420 second interval that needs no accumulation.

Escalation and referrals. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: the admissible artifacts do not contradict one another on arrival, dwell or rider presence; rider and driver disputes_with_counterparty_90d read 0 and 0 against the 2 limb (c) requires; rider no_show_disputes_30d is 0 against the 3 limb (d) names; the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is clean; and the deciding facts rest on complete weight 1.0 artifacts, so limb (e) is not reached. Confidence is 0.95, above the 0.70 floor. No clause produces a referral on these facts, so referrals is empty. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the refund executes automatically on issue and reverses the rider's charge.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).
